policies.text: Auto Collision Coverage: Covers damage to your vehicle from collisions with other vehicles or objects. Standard deductible is $500. Maximum coverage is $50,000 per incident. Claims must be filed within 30 days of the incident. A police report is required for claims over $2,000.
Bodily Injury Coverage: Covers medical expenses resulting from an auto accident. Maximum coverage is $100,000 per person. Medical documentation is required.
Theft and Vandalism Coverage: Covers loss or damage from theft or vandalism. Deductible is $250. A police report must be filed within 48 hours.

General Claims Policy: All claims require a valid policy number and incident date. Claims are reviewed within 5 business days. The policyholder is responsible for the deductible amount before coverage applies.
